text:
olivia: quick sync - decision on prefetch defaults for SDKs (py/ts/go). server-owned by default or client? layout tradeoffs.

mike: current state: server sometimes prefetches, SDKs also do basic prefetch -> double requests occasionally.

sara: prefer server-owned for hosted: central telemetry, enforce global rate limits. SDKs get opt-out.

raj: private/dedicated installs need client-first defaults. server default could be surprising there.

olivia: compromise: keep SDK surface identical; default = server for hosted, client for private/dedicated based on environment metadata.

casey: API suggestion (same shape across langs):
```
client = RedwoodClient({
  prefetch: {
    mode: "auto", // auto|server|client|off
    window_tokens: 128
  }
})
```
where auto resolves to server if host metadata present.

mike: concerns: (1) who handles prefetch backoff/retry, (2) old SDKs + new server -> double-prefetch.

sara: (1) component that performs prefetch handles its own backoff; SDKs still need idempotent cancel/resume. (2) add capability header `x-prefetch-capable: 1` in server responses; SDKs detect and disable client prefetch for that request. lightweight versioned handshake.

raj: transport: prefer unary header handshake by default; provide optional control stream for long-lived sessions where server can push adjustments. streaming increases complexity in some SDKs.

casey: session API sketch:
```
// python
session = client.open_session({"prefetchStream": true})
// ts
const session = client.session({prefetchStream: true})
```
session receives `prefetch_window_adjust` events.

mike: token accounting: speculative prefetch may consume tokens. bill only when model actually uses tokens; add telemetry label `prefetch_speculative=true`. default conservative window (128).

raj: long-term: unify prefetch + kv-cache into single client-side cache policy module so strategies can be swapped w/o API changes. add to roadmap.

olivia: decision summary: hosted = server-owned default, private/dedicated = client default, SDK opt-out flag, server capability header `x-prefetch-capable`, unary header + optional session stream, default window_tokens=128, telemetry labels + e2e tests for old-sdk fallback.

casey: i'll open a short RFC PR with API examples, header names, migration notes.

dev-bot: deploy-bot: created issue INFR-2210: "prefetch ownership defaults + sdk handshake" assigned to @casey.

mike: will add e2e test cases (old sdk + new server), and a load test for speculative waste.

sara: i'll spec telemetry fields and billing attribution.

raj: proto draft for session control stream coming shortly.

olivia: thanks all. closing thread for now. :rocket:
